notes: Hive is a SQL warehouse reached over Thrift/JDBC, not a REST API, so this OpenAPI document is synthesized from the adaptor surface (ast.json). The adaptor exposes exactly one public operation — query(sql) — and it is modelled as POST /query returning a tabular QueryResult. Common/utility exports (fn, each, field, …) are excluded as they are not external calls. Verified against ast.json: 1 of 1 operation covered. The server URL is a mock placeholder; there is no real HTTP endpoint.
